problem.size: The raid size must be a positive number.
problem.tooBig: No raid fits more than {max} players.
problem.compNumbers: The composition needs numbers from 0 up.
problem.compTooBig: The composition ({planned}) is bigger than the raid ({size}).
problem.duration: The duration must be between {min} and {max} minutes.
problem.maxOverSize: {label}: maximum is greater than the size {size}.
problem.color: The colour must be given as #rrggbb, e.g. #8a7cff.
problem.imageLong: The image URL may be at most {max} characters long.
problem.imageHttps: The image URL must start with https://.
problem.negative: Tanks and healers must not be negative.
problem.tanksHealers: Tanks + healers ({sum}) do not fit into size {limit}.
problem.minimums: Tanks, healers and the melee/ranged minimums ({sum}) do not fit into size {limit}.

fields.instancesTip: Several possible, e.g. SSC + TK in one evening. The sizes and the suggested tanks and healers come from the rule set.
fields.incompleteTip: Info missing: bosses and final boss are not known yet.
fields.sizeTip: The allowed sizes of the chosen instances. “free” for any other size up to 40. Changing it suggests tanks and healers anew.
fields.lookTip: Colour bar and image of the signup message. Leave empty: colour and boss icon of the evening's biggest instance — so SSC, BT and Hyjal already look different on their own.
fields.thumbnailTip: Small, next to the message text.
fields.buffsTip: Buffs the raid should bring — the setup suggestion plans someone in for each and warns when nobody brings them.
